deepcharter.ore.company_rock_cutter_hot: Company rock: the cutter runs hot, repair the hull first
deepcharter.ore.first_fuel: Coal, charcoal and biofuel are heavy too. A pack of them slows you down and cuts your pod's lift. The pump is lighter.
deepcharter.ore.first_pickup: Ore is heavy. It slows you down and won't stack. Haul it in your pod's cargo bay.
deepcharter.ore.tooltip.haul: Won't stack. Haul it in your pod's cargo bay.
deepcharter.ore.tooltip.heavy: Heavy: it slows you while you carry it.
